description: Auto-rig a 3D model file (.glb, .gltf with everything embedded, or .fbx; up to 200 MB) and write the rigged .glb with its animations. Takes about a minute. Returns where the file was written.

animations.description: all (default), none (just the rig), or animation names from list_body_types

facing.description: which way the model faces, in degrees about its up axis; auto works it out

keep_arms_out.description: humans: keep the arms out of the body in every animation, on this computer after the download, as afk.ai/rig does (seconds to a minute)

output.description: where to write the rigged .glb (default: <model>.rigged.glb next to it)

path.description: the model file (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

type.description: what the model is: human for anything on two legs, fox for dogs/cats/wolves, horse for hoofed animals, and so on

name: rig_model
